characters.name: Miss Nova
characters.appearance: White humanoid robot face with blue eyes, smooth metallic skin, visible neck joints. No clothing, just the robot chassis.

characters.name: Rahul
characters.appearance: Young adult male, slim build, dark hair. Static posture, back to camera.
characters.wardrobe: Light pink long-sleeve shirt and khaki pants.

characters.name: Priya
characters.appearance: Young adult female, dark shoulder-length hair. Static posture, back to camera.
characters.wardrobe: Denim jacket and a yellow floral skirt.

scenes.supernova_script:
Miss Nova says: Hello, what is your name?
Rahul says: My name is Rahul.
Miss Nova says: How old are you?
Rahul says: I have 22.
Miss Nova says: Not 'I have 22', it should be 'I am 22 years old'.
Rahul says: Okay, I am 22 years old.
Miss Nova says: Where are you from?
Rahul says: I am Uttar Pradesh.
Miss Nova says: Not 'I am Uttar Pradesh', it is 'I am from Uttar Pradesh'.
Rahul says: Oh, okay. I always freeze when I have to speak English.
Miss Nova says: That is completely normal. I am Miss Nova. I teach you to speak English on Supernova AI, and I explain the logic in your own language.
Rahul says: But won't people laugh at my mistakes?
Miss Nova says: Not here. You can make a thousand mistakes, and I will correct you without ever judging you.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Hook: Relatable Indian-English error and live correction.
- Payload: Names English early, introduces Miss Nova, lands logic in your language (g).
- Payload: Sets up privacy/no-judgement (b) as the core reassurance.
